summary: This directory centralizes the business logic and orchestration for managing user entities, including identity retrieval, lookup, and membership validation within the application domain.
responsibilities: Provide operations for retrieving user identity information
Enable lookup of specific user records by identifier
Manage and verify user membership relations
relationships: The User Service acts as the primary gateway for querying user data and inspecting membership status.
Membership relations are validated through the User Service interface to ensure data consistency.
designDecisions: Service layer abstraction for user-related business operations
Interface-based definition for user management tasks
